page_title: SEV 1-1 BET | Sevilla v Betis 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Hector Bellerin (Betis) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+3' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the right post!

90+2' German Pezzella (Betis) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
90+2' Isco (Betis) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

90+2' Hector Bellerin (Betis) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom right corner lacks power and Marko Dmitrovic easily makes the save. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Isco (Betis) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Diego Alonso has decided to substitute Jesus Navas and he is replaced by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla).
87' Substitution. Djibril Sow did his best and is replaced by Mariano Diaz (Sevilla).
84' Suso (Sevilla) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
84' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Sevilla win a corner kick.
83' A snap shot by Suso (Sevilla) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Francisco Vieites produces a good save to thwart him.
82' Luiz Henrique (Betis) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.

79' 1 - 1 A wonderful pass found its target. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) received it well and shot from about 28 metres out. He did really well to send the ball past the goalkeeper and into the top left corner.
78' Loic Bade (Sevilla) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
77' Corner kick. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is ready to send the ball into the box.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Luiz Henrique (Betis) coming on for Willian Jose.
75' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) swings in a cross from the corner, but Francisco Vieites reads it well and gathers the ball.
75' A pass into the penalty area from Jesus Navas (Sevilla) is intercepted by the defence. Sevilla force a corner. They send men into the box.
74' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
73' A substitution has been made. Lucas Ocampos is replaced by Suso (Sevilla).
72' 0 - 1 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Betis) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
72' Isco (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
72' Betis decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
71' The game is interrupted. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
70' Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul after Marc Roca (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
68' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
65' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Abner (Betis) replaces Juan Miranda.
64' Substitution. Assane Diao makes way for Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
64' A dangerous looking corner kick from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is cleared to safety by the defence.
63' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
62' We are about to witness a substitution. Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is replacing Oliver Torres.

62' Ayoze Perez (Betis) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Marko Dmitrovic makes a great save to stop his effort.
62' A rebound bounces out to Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
57' CLOSE! Ayoze Perez (Betis) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
56' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Gil Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
54' Isco (Betis) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
54' Assane Diao (Betis) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Betis win a corner.
52' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
52' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
50' Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Guido Rodriguez (Betis).
47' The referee blows his whistle as Marc Roca (Betis) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Jesus Gil Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' The game is interrupted now, Juan Miranda (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Isco (Betis) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
43' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
42' It must be a yellow card. It is. Juan Miranda (Betis) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
40' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
38' The resulting corner from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
35' Close! Juan Miranda (Betis) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.

35' Juan Miranda (Betis) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early low towards the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a great save to deny him.
34' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Francisco Vieites comes off his line to gather the ball.
31' Assane Diao (Betis) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
31' The free kick into the penalty area from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is cleared.
27' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle after Jesus Navas (Sevilla) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
27' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
23' The linesman signals that Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
20' Francisco Vieites makes a difficult save to deny Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla), who attempted to head into the top right corner from inside the box.
18' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the left post.
18' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
16' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Betis due to an offside in the build-up play.
16' Wait! Referee Jesus Gil Manzano has indicated he is going to review the Betis goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
15' It's in the back of the net! Hector Bellerin (Betis) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Marko Dmitrovic. He makes it 0:1.
15' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Betis.
13' The corner from Isco (Betis) is intercepted by the defence.

13' Isco (Betis) sends a low pass into the box, towards Guido Rodriguez. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Betis are going to take it.
11' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Marc Roca (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jesus Gil Manzano blows for a foul.
8' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

7' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Sevilla force their opponents to concede a corner.
7' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Isco (Betis) takes the corner which is cleared.

3' Guido Rodriguez (Betis) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Betis earn a corner.
3' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) commits a rough foul. Jesus Gil Manzano stops the game and makes a call.
1' Isco (Betis) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Marko Dmitrovic makes a comfortable save.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
